design.concept: The logo is a stack of three cards; the deck is about what comes off the top of that stack. Every piece of proof is a real output of the tool, pulled off a pile of slides.
design.signature_device: The stack: the mark's three offset rounded cards (Coral, Violet, Ink/white) at the mark's own offsets. They Morph from the title into the frame behind the first product image, then into the brief → brand → deck panels, and return as the offset layers behind real screenshots.
compositions: dark title with the big stack
design.background_strategy: Ink for title, the numbers slide and the close; Mist for the brand and review slides; white for the rest.
design.transition_default: fade; Morph 1→2→3 so the logo's stack becomes the product frame and then the three panels
design.animation_policy: Builds only where order tells the story: the three panels (brief, kit, deck), the before → after pair, the numbers. Fade or float, never on headlines.

slides.notes: QA forgives ±2 px of renderer jitter. A rewrapped line, a shifted block or a wrong colour fails the build.
